description: Land Title Settlement Department - Calling for claims to property of intestate in Heeralugedara, Divulapitiya D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 510031 and to 12 other properties
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land and property matters, specifically notices calling for claims to intestate property under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed land descriptions, parcel numbers, cadastral map references, and procedures for registering land titles - all characteristic of land-related administrative matters. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette, further confirming its classification as a Land Gazette.
